section_page_counts.description: Number of pages in each section. `section_page_counts[i]` = page count for `sections[i]`.

compound_shape_templates.description:
Document-wide library of CompoundShape templates. Each instance on a
page references one of these templates by ID.

custom_arrows.description:
Document-wide library of user-defined arrow shapes (plan_202).
Referenced from [`ArrowShape::Custom`] on Line / Curve / Connector
endpoints.

view_state.description:
Persisted view state read from / written to the file (plan_204).
Not part of the editable content; injected into the snapshot at save
time and consumed once at open time, so the live document keeps it
`None` to avoid spurious dirty flags from scrolling/zooming.

description:
`GET /api/v1/docs/{doc_id}` の `document`、`PUT` のボディ、`replace_document` Op の `document`。同期対象外の `view_state` は API では返らず、`pages[].page_no` は受信側が再計算する（docs/16 §4）。位置・寸法（x, y, width, height, 角丸, 余白, dash）は mm、線幅（thickness / stroke_width / border_width）は pt、`Run.font_size` と `InputField.font_size` は論理 px（96dpi。pt × 96/72）、回転は度（時計回り）。原点はページ左上、y 軸は下向き。色は `#` 無しの 6 桁 RGB hex。ID は UUIDv7 文字列で、`Run.id` を省略すると自動採番される。

Top-level document.
Pages are stored in a flat Vec for efficient access; section boundaries
are tracked via `section_page_counts`.
Templates are stored as named reusable assets at document level.
title: hogandoc Document

Template.description:
Named page template applied to sections.
Stored at document level and referenced by name from sections.

lines.description:
Lines (罫線) belonging to this region. y-coords are region-local just
like `Block.y`, so the same `abs_y → region` resolution rules apply.

curves.description:
Curves (cubic Bezier) belonging to this region. The four control point
y-coords are region-local; bucketing uses the midpoint of all four ys.

connectors.description:
Connectors belonging to this region. Free-floating connectors store
`source_y` / `target_y` region-local; attached connectors keep block
references and resolve coordinates against the template's block set.

compound_shapes.description: Compound shape instances. `inst.y` is region-local just like `Block.y`.

groups.description:
Object groups inside this region. Each group references region-local
object IDs (block / line / curve / connector / compound_shape).
Groups never span regions — header / content / footer keep their own.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7). Generate a fresh UUIDv7 for `add`; must match `object.id`.

word_wrap.description: Whether text wraps at the block boundary.

text_insets.description:
Inner text insets in mm (per side). Used by Text blocks when laying
out their runs; shape blocks keep label padding on
`ShapeLabel.insets` instead. Round-trips with DrawingML `bodyPr`
lIns/tIns/rIns/bIns.

line_spacing.description:
Line spacing for Text-block runs. Default `Multiple(1.0)` = the
historical `(asc+desc)*1.2` line height. Round-trips with
DrawingML `<a:lnSpc>`.

content.description:
What the block draws: `{"Text": [runs]}`, `{"Image": {...}}`, `{"Rect": {...}}` etc.
(externally tagged enum, see `BlockContent`).

border_color.description: Border color as 6-digit hex (e.g. "000000"). None = default per block type.

border_width.description: Border width in points. None = default (1pt).

border_visible.description: Whether the border is visible. Default true.

background_color.description:
Background color as 6-digit hex (e.g. "FFFF00"). None = transparent.

Overloaded by block kind: for Text / Image / Input blocks this is the
block rectangle's background; for shape blocks (Rect / Circle /
Triangle / Diamond / Callout) it is the *shape interior fill
override* (`"NONE"` = no fill). Resolve it through
[`crate::render_geometry::resolve_shape_fill`] rather than reading it
directly, so every render surface agrees.

background_gradient.description:
Optional gradient fill, taking precedence over `background_color`
(plan_300). Carries the same block-kind overload as
`background_color`: block rectangle background for Text / Image /
Input, shape interior fill for shape blocks.

Invariant: whenever this is `Some`, `background_color` holds
[`Gradient::base_hex`] so code paths that don't understand gradients
(older files, degrade targets, unported render surfaces) still show a
sensible solid color.

corner_radius.description:
Corner radius in mm applied to the block's border + background fill.
Default `0.0` = sharp corners. For Text / Image / Input blocks this
is the only corner-radius field; for shape blocks (Rect / Triangle /
Diamond) the dedicated `RectData / TriangleData / DiamondData
.corner_radius` is the source of truth, so `Block::corner_radius`
stays at 0.0 there. Use `Block::effective_corner_radius()` to read
the right value generically without inspecting `BlockContent`.

rotation.description:
Clockwise rotation in degrees (0.0..360.0) applied around the block's
bounding-box center. Default `0.0` = no rotation. Applies to every
block kind (Rect / Circle / Triangle / Diamond / Text / Image / Input).

bound_compound_shape_id.description:
If set, this block is visually bound to a CompoundShape instance
(typically a label dropped on the shape via double-click). When
bound, the block's own background fill is suppressed and edits
to its background color are routed to the bound CompoundShape's
`fill_color_override` so the fill follows the shape's outline,
not the label's rectangle.

label.description:
Optional embedded text label for shape blocks (Rect / Circle /
Triangle / Diamond). Painted inside the block's content area with
`padding` inset on all sides. Always `None` for Text / Image /
Input blocks; their content kind already carries text or imagery.

auto_size.description: Auto-size behavior (plan_341). Only consulted for Text blocks.

writing_mode.description: Writing direction (plan_342). Only consulted for Text blocks.

shadow.description:
Drop shadow (plan_339). Rendered for shape blocks
(Rect/Circle/Triangle/Diamond); ignored for text/image/input
blocks. `None` = no shadow.

Block.description: A rectangular block positioned on a page.

TextInsets.description:
Per-side inner text insets in mm. Maps 1:1 to DrawingML `bodyPr`'s
`lIns` / `tIns` / `rIns` / `bIns` so Office round-trips preserve
asymmetric margins.

oneOf.description:
Multiplier on the standard line height `(asc + desc) * 1.2`.
`1.0` = unchanged.

LineSpacing.description:
Line spacing for a text block / shape label. Maps to DrawingML
`<a:lnSpc>`: `Multiple` ↔ `spcPct` (ratio pass-through), `ExactPt` ↔
`spcPts`. The default `Multiple(1.0)` keeps the historical line height
`(ascent + descent) * 1.2` and is intentionally NOT exported as
`lnSpc` (plan_257: spcPct is relative to the font's natural line
height, so always emitting 120% widened Excel's line spacing).

oneOf.description:
MS Office 互換の吹き出し(callout)。本体＋可動の矢印(しっぽ)。
ジオメトリは OOXML プリセット(`preset` + `adjusts`)から評価する
(`preset_geom::build_preset_geometry`)。plan_250。

表(テーブル)。行・列・セルを持ち、セルごとにテキストを保持する。
plan_358。

id.description:
Unique id (UUIDv7), consistent with every other document object.
Runs are split and merged constantly while editing: a split gives the
trailing half a fresh id and the leading half keeps the original, and
a merge keeps the leading run's id.

font_size.description:
フォントサイズ。単位はアプリ論理 px (96dpi) — pt ではない。
[`FONT_PX_TO_PT`] / [`FONT_PT_TO_PX`] 参照。

text_align.description:
Per-paragraph horizontal alignment override. Resolved by looking
at the run that contains the paragraph's start byte: when `Some`,
that paragraph (and its wrapped lines) align according to this
value; when `None`, the containing block's `text_align` is used
as a fallback. Storing this on the run lets a single block hold
paragraphs with different alignments without a separate
per-paragraph data structure.

para.description:
Per-paragraph style (spacing / indents / line-spacing override).
Same resolution rule as `text_align`: the run containing the
paragraph's start byte carries the style. `None` = all defaults.

letter_spacing_pt.description:
Extra letter spacing in pt added to each glyph-cluster advance
(plan_340). Negative narrows. `None` = normal spacing. Mirrors ODF
`fo:letter-spacing` and DrawingML `rPr@spc` (1/100 pt).

script.description:
Superscript / subscript (plan_340). Rendered at 58% of `font_size`
with a baseline shift of ±33% (the LibreOffice defaults); line
height is computed from the *unscaled* size so scripts don't change
line spacing. Mirrors ODF `style:text-position` and DrawingML
`rPr@baseline` (both quantized to Super/Sub on import).

highlight.description:
Text highlight color (RGB hex without `#`) painted behind the run
(plan_340). Mirrors ODF `fo:background-color` (text-properties) and
DrawingML `<a:highlight>`.

Run.description: A run of text with uniform formatting.

space_before_pt.description: Space before the paragraph's first line (pt). DrawingML `spcBef`.

space_after_pt.description: Space after the paragraph's last line (pt). DrawingML `spcAft`.

first_line_indent_mm.description:
First-line indent (mm); negative = hanging indent. DrawingML
`indent`.

line_spacing.description:
Per-paragraph line-spacing override; `None` = the block / label
value.

ParagraphStyle.description:
Per-paragraph style. Held by the run containing the paragraph's start
byte (same resolution rule as [`Run::text_align`]), so a flat
`Vec<Run>` can carry paragraphs with differing spacing / indents
without a separate paragraph structure. Maps to DrawingML `<a:pPr>`:
spcBef / spcAft / marL / marR / indent / lnSpc.

RunContent.description: Content of a run: either text or input (exclusive).

font_size.description: Font size in points for rendering the input value.

font_color.description: Font color as hex string (e.g. "FF0000"), None = black.

InputFormat.description: Data format applied to Text and Select inputs.

ThresholdAction.description: Action taken when a value falls outside the min/max range.

SelectOption.description: A single select option with display label and stored value.

CheckboxOption.description: A single checkbox item within a checkbox group.

RadioLayout.description: Layout direction for radio button / checkbox groups.

RadioOption.description: A single radio option with display label and stored value.

ImageData.description:
Serialized form of [`ImageData`] (plan_288). The in-memory `src` keeps the
`data:<mime>;base64,` URI, but persisting that string would embed base64
(+33%) inside the binary .jhg format, so a data-URI src is split into its
mime and raw bytes (msgpack bin via `serde_bytes`) at the serde boundary.
Non-data-URI srcs (empty placeholder, external refs) pass through as text.
Only .jhg uses serde — the XML format has its own hand-written writer.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius in mm (0 = sharp corners).

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Consulted only when
`stroke_style == StrokeStyle::Dashed`.

RectData.description: Data for a rectangle shape block.

oneOf.description:
Sinusoidal wavy outline. Renders via the same `paint_wavy_polyline`
helper used by Line / Curve / Connector so wavy strokes look
identical regardless of which kind of object draws them.

dash_mm.description: Length of one dash in mm.

gap_mm.description: Gap between two consecutive dashes in mm.

DashPattern.description:
Customisable parameters for the `Dashed` stroke style. Both fields
are in millimetres so the visual pitch is independent of the line's
stroke thickness — matching the user's intent of predictable dash
patterns. Carriers store a `DashPattern` regardless of their current
`LineStyle` / `StrokeStyle`; the value is only consulted by the
dashed renderer, so non-dashed objects pay nothing for it.

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Consulted only when
`stroke_style == StrokeStyle::Dashed`.

CircleData.description: Data for a circle shape block.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius in mm (0 = sharp corners).

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Consulted only when
`stroke_style == StrokeStyle::Dashed`.

TriangleData.description: Data for a triangle shape block.

corner_radius.description:
Corner radius in mm (0 = sharp corners). Each of the four
vertices is replaced by an inscribed arc of this radius;
the stroke follows the rounded outline so visual consistency
with rect / triangle is preserved.

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Consulted only when
`stroke_style == StrokeStyle::Dashed`.

DiamondData.description: Data for a diamond (rhombus) shape block.

adjusts.description:
Adjustment value overrides as `(name, fmla)` where fmla is `"val N"`.
Empty = use the preset definition's defaults.

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Consulted only when
`stroke_style == StrokeStyle::Dashed`.

origin.description:
作成元のパレット / 取込形式(plan_404)。旧ファイルは属性が無いので
`DrawingMl`。表示は [`CalloutData::family`] を使う。

CalloutData.description:
Data for a callout (吹き出し) shape block. plan_250.

The geometry is not stored explicitly; it is evaluated on demand from the
OOXML preset definition (`preset`, e.g. "wedgeRectCallout") plus the
adjustment values (`adjusts`, in `(name, "val N")` form) via
`preset_geom::build_preset_geometry`. The movable arrow ("tail") is driven
by the preset's adjustment handles (`preset_geom::preset_adjust_handles`).
Block geometry (x/y/width/height/rotation/label) is reused from `Block`.

ShapeFamily.description:
図形ファミリ(plan_404)。プロパティパネルの「種別」に
`四角形 (hogandoc)` / `角丸四角形 (drawingml)` のように併記する。

- `Hogandoc`: hogandoc 固有の図形(Rect / Circle / Line / 手組みの複合図形 等)。
- `DrawingMl` / `DrawIo` / `Odf`: サイドバーの各パレット、または各形式の
  取込で作られた preset 図形・複合図形。

ODF / draw.io パレットの preset id は DrawingML と同じ id(`rect` 等)を
共有するためデータからは由来を判別できず、`CalloutData::origin` に
作成元を保持する。`Default` は preset 図形の既定由来 `DrawingMl`。

dash_pattern.description: 破線パターン (mm)。`stroke_style == Dashed` のときのみ参照。

fill_color.description:
既定のセル塗り (6桁 hex または "NONE")。`TableCell::fill_color` が
`None` のセルに適用される。

header_fill.description: ヘッダ行(先頭行)の塗り。`None` = 通常のセルと同じ。

TableData.description:
Data for a table (表) block. plan_358.

行数 = `row_heights.len()`、列数 = `col_widths.len()`。`cells` は
row-major で長さが `rows * cols` に等しいことを不変条件とする（結合で
覆われたセルも要素としては保持し、`row_span == 0` で表す）。

`Block::width` / `Block::height` は列幅・行高の総和と一致させる
（[`TableData::resize_to`] がリサイズ時の比例配分を行う）。セル矩形と
罫線分の算出は `render_geometry::table_cell_rects` /
`render_geometry::table_grid_lines` を唯一の真実源とし、canvas / PDF /
SVG / ODF / DrawingML はすべてそこを経由する。

row_span.description: 縦方向の結合数。`1` = 非結合、`0` = 上のセルに覆われている。

col_span.description: 横方向の結合数。`1` = 非結合、`0` = 左のセルに覆われている。

borders.description:
セル個別の罫線(plan_378)。`None` = 表の `stroke_*` に従う。
Excel 貼り付けのように「セルごとに線の有無・太さ・色が違う」表を
表現する。隣接セルと共有する辺の解決は
`render_geometry::table_border_segments` 参照。

TableCell.description:
表の 1 セル。テキストは既存の [`Run`] 列をそのまま使うので、書式・
レイアウト (`layout::text::build_text_block`)・IME が共有できる。

CellBorders.description: セルの 4 辺。各辺 `None` = 表の既定に従う。

CellBorder.description: セルの 1 辺の罫線。`width_pt == 0.0` は「引かない」。

angle.description: 度。CSS / gpui 準拠で 0 = 上向き、時計回り。`Radial` では無視。

Gradient.description:
グラデーション塗り。

不変条件（`normalize` が保証する）:
- `stops.len()` は `2..=MAX_GRADIENT_STOPS`
- `stops` は `pos` 昇順
- すべての `pos` は `0.0..=1.0`

oneOf.description: 線形。`Gradient::angle` の向きに色が変化する。
放射（中心から外周へ）。`Gradient::angle` は無視される。

GradientKind.description: グラデーションの種別。

pos.description: グラデーション線上の位置 `0.0..=1.0`。

color.description:
`RRGGBB` または `RRGGBBAA`（`#` なし）。塗りなしの `"NONE"`
センチネルはここには入らない（グラデーション自体を `None` に
することで表現する）。

insets.description:
Per-side padding inside the shape's visible bbox in mm.
Round-trips with DrawingML `bodyPr` lIns/tIns/rIns/bIns.

line_spacing.description:
Line spacing for the label runs. Default `Multiple(1.0)` = the
historical `(asc+desc)*1.2` line height. Round-trips with
DrawingML `<a:lnSpc>`.

ShapeLabel.description:
Optional text label embedded in a CompoundShapeInstance. The label has
no background or border of its own — those are conceptually the shape's
fill / stroke. Painted inside the shape's visible bbox with `padding`
inset (mm) on all sides.

oneOf.description: Fixed box (default) — text may overflow / clip.
Block height follows the laid-out content height after editing.

Font sizes are scaled down at render time so the content fits
the fixed box (never scaled up).

AutoSize.description:
Auto-size behavior of a Text block (plan_341). Mirrors ODF
`draw:auto-grow-height` / `draw:fit-to-size` and DrawingML bodyPr
`<a:spAutoFit/>` / `<a:normAutofit/>`.

oneOf.description:
Vertical, top-to-bottom columns right-to-left (ODF `tb-rl`).
Rendered as a 90°-rotated horizontal layout (all glyphs rotate —
CJK upright composition is a future plan; see plan_342).

WritingMode.description:
Writing direction of a Text block (plan_342). Mirrors ODF
`style:writing-mode` and DrawingML `bodyPr@vert`.

ShapeShadow.description:
Drop shadow for shape-like objects (plan_339). Mirrors ODF
`draw:shadow-*` (graphic-properties) and DrawingML `a:outerShdw`.
Offset is in page mm (applied after rotation, matching LibreOffice);
`opacity` is 0.0..=1.0 (1.0 = opaque).

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7). Generate a fresh UUIDv7 for `add`; must match `object.id`.

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Only consulted when
`style == LineStyle::Dashed`; carriers always store a value to
keep the field non-optional and round-trip cleanly.

start_arrow.description: Arrow head at the start point (`x1`, `y1`).

end_arrow.description: Arrow head at the end point (`x2`, `y2`).

start_arrow_size.description: Size of the start arrow head.

end_arrow_size.description: Size of the end arrow head.

Line.description: A line (罫線) positioned on a page, defined by two endpoints.

oneOf.description:
Two parallel thin strokes with a fixed gap. Mirrors
`StrokeStyle::Double` for shapes — both kinds resolve to the
shared `paint_double_polyline` painter so a "double line"
looks the same on lines, curves, connectors, and shape
outlines.
Outlined V-shaped triangle (two strokes, no fill).

User-defined arrow shape (plan_202). The string is a `CustomArrow.id`
looked up in `Document::custom_arrows`.

ArrowShape.description:
Shape of an arrow head drawn at the start / end of a line, curve, or
connector. Common across all three line-like object kinds so the
property panel can drive them through a single dropdown surface.

`Custom(id)` references a `CustomArrow` in the document-level library
(plan_202). When the referenced id doesn't exist the renderer treats
it as `None` (silent fallback). `Custom` carries a `SharedString` so
this enum is no longer `Copy`; clone where needed.

ArrowSize.description:
Size of an arrow head. Maps to a base length in points; the head's
width is derived as 0.7 × length. Independent of the line's stroke
thickness.

LineCap.description:
Stroke end-cap shape for line-like objects (plan_338). Mirrors
ODF `svg:stroke-linecap` / DrawingML `a:ln@cap` / SVG `stroke-linecap`.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7). Generate a fresh UUIDv7 for `add`; must match `object.id`.

cx1.description: First control point X in mm.

cy1.description: First control point Y in mm.

cx2.description: Second control point X in mm.

cy2.description: Second control point Y in mm.

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Only consulted when
`style == LineStyle::Dashed`.

start_arrow.description: Arrow head at the start point (`x0`, `y0`).

end_arrow.description: Arrow head at the end point (`x3`, `y3`).

start_arrow_size.description: Size of the start arrow head.

end_arrow_size.description: Size of the end arrow head.

Curve.description:
A cubic Bezier curve positioned on a page, defined by four control points.
Coordinates are absolute in mm (page-relative), like Line.

LineJoin.description:
Stroke corner-join shape for multi-segment line-like objects
(plan_338). Mirrors ODF `draw:stroke-linejoin` / DrawingML
`a:round`/`a:bevel`/`a:miter` / SVG `stroke-linejoin`.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7). Generate a fresh UUIDv7 for `add`; must match `object.id`.

source_block_id.description:
Source block ID. Empty string means the source endpoint is not attached
to any block; fall back to `source_x` / `source_y`.

source_edge.description: Which edge of the source block.

source_cxn_idx.description:
Index into the source shape's connection sites (`<cxnLst>`) when the
endpoint snapped to a specific MS Office connection point. `None` =
legacy edge-midpoint behavior driven by `source_edge`. (plan_251)

source_x.description:
Source position in mm (used when `source_block_id` is empty or the
referenced block is missing).

target_block_id.description: Target block ID. Empty string means the target endpoint is not attached.

target_edge.description: Which edge of the target block.

target_cxn_idx.description:
Index into the target shape's connection sites (`<cxnLst>`). `None` =
legacy edge-midpoint behavior. (plan_251)

target_x.description: Target position in mm (used when `target_block_id` is empty or missing).

curve_offset.description:
Curve offset for the bezier bulge (adjustable via drag). In mm.
Perpendicular to the source→target line — positive values bulge to one side.

curve_offset_along.description:
Additional midpoint displacement along the source→target direction. In mm.
Allows dragging the midpoint freely in 2D, not only perpendicular.

routing.description: Connector routing (path shape: curve, straight, orthogonal).

dash_pattern.description:
Dash length / gap pattern (mm). Only consulted when
`line_style == LineStyle::Dashed`.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius in mm for orthogonal routing. 0 means sharp corners.

waypoints.description:
Explicit corner waypoints for orthogonal routing, in page-absolute mm,
ordered source→target. The full vertex list is `[source] + waypoints +
[target]`. When empty the path is derived from `curve_offset` /
`curve_offset_along` (legacy / backward-compatible). When non-empty the
user manages corners explicitly; waypoints stay put (absolute) when an
attached block moves — only the endpoint legs re-route.

start_arrow.description: Arrow head at the source endpoint.

end_arrow.description: Arrow head at the target endpoint.

start_arrow_size.description: Size of the source arrow head.

end_arrow_size.description: Size of the target arrow head.

Connector.description: A connector curve that links two blocks via their edge centers.

ConnectorEdge.description: Which edge of a block a connector attaches to.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7). Generate a fresh UUIDv7 for `add`; must match `object.id`.

template_id.description: ID of the CompoundShapeTemplate this instance refers to.

x.description: Anchor position in mm (the template's origin is placed here).

scale_x.description:
Per-axis scale factor applied to the template's relative coordinates.
`1.0` means render the template at its original size.

rotation.description:
Clockwise rotation in degrees (0.0..360.0) applied around the instance's
visible bounding-box center. Default `0.0` = no rotation.

flip_h.description:
Horizontal mirror around the visible bounding-box center, applied
before `rotation` (plan_338; ODF `draw:mirror-horizontal` /
DrawingML `a:xfrm@flipH` と同順序).

flip_v.description:
Vertical mirror around the visible bounding-box center, applied
before `rotation` (plan_338).

fill_color_override.description:
Optional per-instance fill color override (RGB hex without `#`).
`None` means use the template's default fill color.

fill_gradient_override.description:
Optional per-instance gradient override, taking precedence over
`fill_color_override` and the template's fill (plan_300). When
`Some`, `fill_color_override` holds [`Gradient::base_hex`].

stroke_color_override.description:
Optional per-instance stroke color override. `None` means use the
template's per-segment color.

stroke_width_override.description:
Optional per-instance stroke width override (pt). `None` means use
the template's per-segment thickness.

stroke_visible.description: Whether the shape's outline (segments) is drawn. Default `true`.

label.description:
Optional embedded text label rendered inside the shape's visible
bbox. Replaces the legacy "Block bound to CompoundShape via
`bound_compound_shape_id`" pattern.

CompoundShapeInstance.description: An instance of a CompoundShapeTemplate placed on a page.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7). Generate a fresh UUIDv7 for `add`; must match `object.id`.

block_ids.description:
Member IDs per object type. All members must live on the same page as
the group. `add` with `parent_id` appends to the right list automatically.

compound_shape_ids.description: CompoundShape (object template) instances that belong to this group.

Group.description: A group of objects that move and resize together.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7), consistent with every other document object.

template_name.description:
Name of the `Template` (in `Document.templates`) applied to every page
of this section. `null` = no template.

title.description:
Optional human-readable title for the section. Displayed in the
property panel and persisted to XML so authors can label e.g.
"Cover", "Chapter 1", etc.

Section.description:
A section optionally references a named template and owns a range of pages.
Pages are stored flat in Document; section_page_counts tracks how many pages each section owns.
`template_name == None` means "no template applied" — header/footer collapse to 0
and the page content area covers the full paper.

`Default` is deliberately **not** derived: it would mint a section with an
empty `id`, and duplicate empty ids break the id's uniqueness guarantee.
Construct through [`Section::new`] so the id is always assigned.

id.description: Unique id (UUIDv7), consistent with every other document object.

page_no.description:
1-based page number. Derived from the position in `pages`; the API
ignores incoming values and recomputes it (send 0).

paper_size.description: Named paper size. `width` / `height` are the authoritative dimensions.

connectors.description: Connectors (コネクタ曲線) on this page.

compound_shapes.description: Compound shape instances on this page (each refs a Document-level template).

groups.description: Groups of objects on this page.

name.description:
Human-readable name shown in the sidebar / property panel. Empty by
default (UI then falls back to `Shape <short-id>`).

fill_color.description:
Fill color (RGB hex without `#`) shared by every region in
`fill_regions`. Use the literal `"NONE"` to disable filling.

fill_gradient.description:
Optional gradient fill for the template, taking precedence over
`fill_color` (plan_300). When `Some`, `fill_color` holds
[`Gradient::base_hex`] as the solid fallback.

segments.description:
All segments that make up the visible strokes. plan_187 collapsed
the previous "closed-chain outline" semantics into a flat stroke
list; the fill is now driven exclusively by `fill_regions`.

decorative_segments.description:
Held over from plan_184/186 for backward compatibility with stored
XML — also rendered as stroke. New templates created in-app keep
this empty.

fill_regions.description:
Polygons that should be filled with `fill_color`. Empty = no fill
(the template appears as line-art only). Each region is added /
removed independently from the edit dialog's paint-bucket UI.

text_rect.description:
Optional text-placement rectangle `(l, t, r, b)` in template-local mm
(plan_246). Captured from a preset shape's `<rect>` definition; used to
position the instance label when the body box differs from the
painted visible bbox (e.g. callouts whose tail extends past the body).
`None` = use the visible bbox (default for hand-built templates).

connection_sites.description:
DrawingML connection sites (`<cxnLst>`) in template-local mm — the
MS Office connector snap points evaluated from the preset's geometry.
Empty = no preset sites (connectors fall back to outline/bbox edge
midpoints). (plan_251)

preset_id.description:
Original DrawingML preset id (ST_ShapeType, e.g. "roundRect") when this
template was imported from a `<a:prstGeom>` shape. `None` for hand-built
or custGeom-derived templates. Preserving the "identity" lets export
emit `<a:prstGeom>` (with adjust handles) instead of baked custGeom, so
Office round-trips keep the live preset. Cleared when the template's
geometry is structurally edited in-app. (plan_252)

preset_adjusts.description:
Preset adjust values (`<a:avLst>`) as `(name, "val N")`, paired with
`preset_id`. Empty = preset defaults. (plan_252)

listed.description:
Whether the template appears in the sidebar's ObjectTemplate list.
`false` for templates created internally as the backing geometry of a
merged shape (線の結合, plan_261) — the instance on the page is the
user-visible object, so the template itself stays out of the panel.

odf_native.description:
ODF (LibreOffice) 取込時の図形 identity (plan_351)。`Some` のとき
ODF 書き出しは焼き込みパスではなく LO ネイティブ定義で復元する。
`preset_id` と同じく、ジオメトリを構造編集したら破棄する。

CompoundShapeTemplate.description:
Document-level reusable shape template. Geometry is stored in
template-local relative coordinates so the template can be instantiated at
any position on any page.

TemplateSegment.description:
One segment of a CompoundShapeTemplate. Holds geometry in template-local
coordinates (origin = template bbox top-left) along with stroke information.

corner_radius.description:
Source shape's corner radius (mm) captured at compound-shape
creation time so the revert flow can restore rounded corners.
`0.0` for sharp shapes and for legacy templates that predate this
field.

TemplateBlockOrigin.description:
Per-edge marker recording which Block in the original selection a
`TemplateSegment` came from. `block_key` is unique within the template
(the original block id at the time of compound-shape creation) — its
value has no semantic meaning, it just groups edges of the same block
when reverting.

TemplateBlockKind.description:
Kind of shape Block a TemplateSegment was carved out of. Used during
"revert object template" to re-assemble the original Block instead of
leaving the perimeter as standalone Lines / Curves. `None` on the
segment's `origin` means the segment was a free Line/Curve to begin with.

color.description:
Per-region fill color (RGB hex without `#`). `None` = use the
template's `fill_color` (legacy single-color behavior). 編集
ダイアログでの領域ごとの明示的な塗り分けに使う(plan_243)。

lum.description:
Per-region luminance modulation `(mod, off)` applied to the
*resolved* base fill color at paint time: `L' = L×mod + off`
(HSL の L 成分)。Office の bevel のような「基本色 + 面ごとの
明暗」を相対指定のまま保持するためのもので、基本色を変えると
全面が濃淡付きで追従する(plan_244)。`color`(絶対色)が
ある場合はそちらが優先。

TemplateFillRegion.description:
One filled region (closed polygon, template-local mm) of a
CompoundShapeTemplate. plan_187 replaced the legacy "fill follows the
segments polyline" model with this explicit list of paint-bucket
regions: users click each enclosed area they want filled and the
dialog records the contour here.

`points` is the outer-boundary polygon; the last point is implicitly
connected back to the first. `holes` lists inner cut-out polygons —
each is a closed ring inside `points` whose interior is *excluded*
from the fill. Empty `holes` keeps the legacy single-ring behavior.

ConnectionSite.description:
A DrawingML connection site (`<cxnLst><cxn ang="...">`) — an MS Office
connector snap point. Position is in template-local mm (origin = top-left);
`ang_deg` is the direction (degrees, clockwise) a connector leaves the point,
used to derive the elbow exit edge. (plan_251)

draw_type.description:
LO ネイティブの `draw:type`。`ooxml-*` / `non-primitive` /
`mso-spt*` は入れない(LO がそれらを定義へ解決しないため。実測)。

modifiers.description: `draw:modifiers` の実値(viewBox 0..21600 空間)。そのまま書き戻す。

box_rect.description:
元の `svg:x/y/width/height` の箱を**テンプレートローカル mm** で
表した `(l, t, r, b)`。吹き出しの尻尾は箱の外へ出るため可視 bbox とは
一致しない。ネイティブ復元では LO が期待する「本体の箱」を書く必要が
あるので、plan_348 の 0 基準正規化のシフト込みで保持する。

OdfNativeGeom.description:
ODF (LibreOffice) 取込時の図形 identity (plan_351)。

LO ネイティブな `draw:type` を持つ custom-shape は、見た目を優先して
enhanced-path を評価した [`CompoundShapeTemplate`] として取り込む
(形状近似ゲートを通らない調整済み図形など)。そのままだと書き出しが
`draw:type="non-primitive"` になり、LO 側で図形の正体と調整ハンドルを
失うため、元の型・調整値・箱を保持して書き戻しで復元する。

[`CompoundShapeTemplate::preset_id`] (DrawingML identity, plan_252) と
対になる ODF 版。ジオメトリを構造編集したら破棄するのも同じ規約。

parts.description:
Parts in draw order (index 0 painted first, so subsequent parts
overlap earlier ones).

CustomArrow.description:
A user-defined arrow head, made of one or more [`ArrowPart`]s. Stored
in [`Document::custom_arrows`] and referenced from
[`ArrowShape::Custom`].

oneOf.description: Straight line segment (stroke only, no fill).
Circle. Stroked with the line color; fill controlled by [`ArrowFill`].
Closed polygon (last point implicitly joins to the first).

Cubic Bézier curve. When `fill != None`, start and end are
connected by a straight line to close the region for filling.

ArrowPart.description:
One geometric primitive inside a [`CustomArrow`]. Coordinates are in
the arrow-local frame: the line endpoint sits at `(0, 0)` and the
line extends along `+X`.

oneOf.description: Fill with the line color (= stroke color).
Pure white fill (used for hollow/whiteout shapes).

ArrowFill.description:
Fill rule for shape parts inside a [`CustomArrow`]. Stroke is always
inherited from the line color so only fill needs an enum.

active_page_index.description: 0-based index of the page that was at the viewport top.

ViewState.description:
Persisted view state: the minimal "where the file was open" snapshot
(plan_204). Stored under `<document>/<view-state>` so reopening a file
restores its zoom and the page the user was looking at. `None` on the
live document means "no saved state" (legacy files / never saved).
